name: COLGATE-PALMOLIVE CO. Registere
summary: Colgate-Palmolive Company is a global consumer products company focused on oral care, personal care, home care, and pet nutrition. The company manufactures and markets a wide range of products under well-known brands such as Colgate, Palmolive, Hill's Science Diet, and Softsoap. Colgate-Palmolive is headquartered in New York City, USA.
